msa_deal_breaker.definition: A quality whose absence ends the possibility, as opposed to one that only lowers the score.
msa_deal_breaker.example: Dishonesty was the deal-breaker, and the rest were preferences.

pump_sump.definition: A pit that collects water from a floor or a basement so that a pump can lift it.
pump_sump.example: The sump in the basement pit fills when the floor drain backs up.
